name: Trading Terminal
description: Terminal gelap berdensitas tinggi untuk pemantauan pasar dan eksekusi cepat.

rules.if: the workflow monitors many states AND the domain is trading
rules.then: prefer a dense workspace layout with price and status always visible
rules.why: the user needs rapid comparison and action

rules.if: a number changes live (price, position, P&L)
rules.then: show it in a table or stat with a status tone, monospaced
rules.why: aligned digits are compared at a glance
